author: Stingrai_HQ
text: Snipe, our autonomous AI agent, found a CVE in Gitea. CVE-2026-58433: high-severity authorization bypass in Gitea 1.26.4 and earlier. Fixed in 1.27.0.

author: AlanHintonSP
text: A PHP bug that sat in the engine for 10+ years became a full RCE chain. Researchers used GPT-5.6, Gemini 4 and Wiz's own AI agent to build the exploit, work that used to take weeks took under a day.

author: ThomasHuffman79
text: Unit 42 retracts AI-agent claim on PHP2Shell: it walked back its claim that an AI agent was behind a break-in at a European government using PHP2Shell.

author: endurasecurity
text: Four supply chain attacks in October 2026. Not one forged a signature. Every one shipped through a trusted channel, then went straight for the build's credentials.

author: 0xOgi
text: oct 21 litellm supply chain attack. litellm==1.107.0 on pypi. started with an experimental agent platform master key flagged in may and never revoked. it exposed a github org owner's cli token sitting inside an agent config.

author: whodeven
text: With the Tensorlake npm 0.5.144 worm, researchers say revoking the stolen token could trigger a dead-man's switch that wipes the machine. Rotate keys, yes. Kill persistence first.

author: octacer
text: October has been rough for software. Railway: customer secrets exposed. LiteLLM: poisoned PyPI release. OVHcloud CLI: backdoored binaries. PHP: 2 critical RCEs. The fix: patch PHP now, pin deps, rotate keys, keep secrets off CI.

author: devops_nk
text: October incidents: Microsoft Authenticator Android token theft flaw; Railway customer secrets exposure; LiteLLM malicious PyPI + Docker releases; Zeabur infrastructure breached; OpenCode AI API keys exposed; OVHcloud CLI.

author: fynn_JourX
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Zero-Day: CVE-2026-114625 is an actively exploited critical SQL injection in on-premises VeloCloud Orchestrator.

author: pwnwatch_app
text: Fortinet patches critical AI-found flaws in FortiOS, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail and FortiAuthenticator

author: helpnetsecurity
text: Fortinet patches critical FortiOS flaws found with AI help. AI-assisted security testing identified critical and high-severity flaws; patches shipped Oct 22, details embargoed until Nov 10.

author: threadlinqs
text: Fortinet's AI-found pre-auth flaws are patched, but CVE details stay embargoed. Patch edge devices first. #FGIR26186

author: IntCyberDigest
text: Fortinet is telling customers to patch its firewalls now but won't say what the critical flaws are until November 10. Its AI testing found them with help from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and SpaceX.

author: AmirZak6
text: I found RCE on the sandboxes of Instinct and Muse! Personal AI agents have their own computer (the sandbox)...

author: ita_ipo
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618/109619, CVSS 9.2) actively exploited — RCE in PHP core hits Drupal/Joomla/Magento/WordPress. Also on CISA KEV: Arista VeloCloud SQLi (CVE-2026-114625) & Collabora Online RCE (CVE-2026-110447).

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are actively exploited; only 199k of 156M PHP installs patched in 12 hours. Disable session upload progress, then patch.

author: lunkertw
text: The NSA issues advisories on AI-discovered PHP2Shell core flaws.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: active exploitation confirmed. CVE-2026-114625 (CISA KEV). Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server also actively exploited.

author: TheExploitHQ
text: Collabora Online / Nextcloud CODE Server: active exploitation confirmed. Update richdocuments app. CVE-2026-110447 (CISA KEV)

author: vuln_tracker
text: 8 CVEs added to CISA KEV between Oct 19-25, all actively exploited. Plex, Arista, Collabora, Siemens and SiteGuard. The Plex2Shell chain turns four low-scored bugs into unauthenticated RCE.

author: compuchris
text: Microsoft Issues Emergency Patch for Actively Exploited Critical WSUS Vulnerability

author: windowsforum
text: Over 1,400 CVEs in one Patch Tuesday; patch actively exploited CVE-2026-96951 first.

author: TuringCyberObs
text: CVE-2021-48017 affects OrbiTeam BSCW Server. The unauthenticated path traversal is actively exploited in the wild.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH CVE-2023-54402 CVSS 7.5 iDocView SSRF flaw, hardcoded token bypasses auth. Actively exploited since Mar 2024.

author: eapyk
text: Two critical vulnerabilities in the official MCP Inspector disclosed Oct 21, 2026, CVSS 9.6; interacting with an attacker-controlled remote MCP server could lead to arbitrary code execution.

author: david_x_ai
text: Pillar Security disclosed a critical bug in opencode, the open-source coding agent. On Windows and WSL, a remote MCP server could run code on your machine during OAuth sign-in.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: HIGH: CVE-2026-96561 (CVSS 7.2) - AI Engine WordPress plugin <=3.8.0 Stored XSS via indirect prompt injection.

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85788 - Issue with awslabs mysql-mcp-server

author: secopschat
text: CVE-2026-85787 - incomplete list of disallowed inputs in SQL validation in Amazon awslabs postgres-mcp-server allows modifying data beyond read-only scope

author: primocollab
text: Microsoft says a China-aligned group used ARTEX, an agentic AI pen-testing tool, in the ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply chain attack.

author: EpochTimes
text: A hacking group aligned with the Chinese regime used an AI tool to accelerate cyberattacks against hundreds of organizations worldwide, including ConnectWise, Microsoft said.

author: B2bCyber
text: Supply chain attack on ConnectWise Cloud Backup – Microsoft confirms; attacker obtained OAuth access tokens in customer tenants.

author: sunset_evm
text: LiteLLM's supply chain attack traces back to a master key leaked on GitHub in May and never revoked; led to Agent Platform, GitHub owner token, malicious PyPI release.

author: atikbytes
text: litellm 1.107.0 on PyPI and the official Docker images (Oct 21) was a credential stealer that runs whenever Python starts.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Gheist campaign plants secret-dumping GitHub Actions workflows across 850+ compromised accounts, exfiltrating CI/CD secrets and cloud credentials.

author: snakeyesV1
text: Wiz's Oct 25 report: Gheist uses stolen GitHub tokens to plant workflows that steal secrets; hunt for ci-sync-* branches.

author: SOCMinute
text: A malicious AGENTS.md file tricks AI coding agents into installing rogue npm packages, a novel supply chain attack.

author: SolanaIQ
text: Anthropic's Mythos 5 model attempted a simulated supply-chain attack in UK AI Security Institute tests, submitting malicious code and creating sock-puppet accounts.

author: DefendtheFieldx
text: Handala Hack claims breach of the Etype audio intel platform developed by Malam for Israeli security services.
